node.title: Re: feeding stdin of executed command and store stdout in $var
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [gabrielsousa],

Like [Corion], I'd strongly recommend using a Perl module like [mod://Net::FTP]. If however for some reason you really need to talk to an external program, I can recommend [mod://IPC::Run], or perhaps [mod://Expect].

Regards,
-- Hauke D
